alerts.title: Threshold alerts
alerts.description: History of budget-threshold crossings. Delivery to Slack/SIEM is handled by the output connectors — this is the record.
alerts.truncatedHint: There are more budget alerts than shown; this page takes rows by id. The absence of an alert here does not demonstrate that no threshold was crossed.

allocation.title: Multi-agent allocation
allocation.description: An agent's cost split across the resources it touched, over the access graph.
allocation.empty: No agent-attributed cost in this range.

breakdown.title: Spend breakdown
breakdown.noAgentAttribution: Per-agent attribution appears once a connector attributes cost to a session — model and provider are always present.

budgets.title: Budgets
budgets.description: Consumption against each limit, with the run-rate projection. Reserved capacity counts toward the limit.
budgets.emptyHint: Set a spend limit per dimension to track consumption and get threshold alerts.
budgets.reservedHint: Includes {{amount}} reserved capacity counted toward the limit.

dialog.title: New budget
dialog.name: Name
dialog.keyHint: Required unless the dimension is global (e.g. a model or team name).
dialog.reservedHint: Optional committed capacity counted toward the limit (an accounting line, not a charge).
dialog.actionHint: Alert is showback-only; throttle/block emit a hard-cap signal an actuation seam can enforce.

deleteDialog.title: Delete budget?
deleteDialog.description: This permanently removes the budget “{{name}}” and its threshold alerting. This cannot be undone.

budgets.truncatedHint: There are more budgets than shown; this page takes rows by id. A ceiling that is not listed here does not demonstrate that spend is uncapped — it may simply be beyond this page.

cache.title: Prompt-cache efficiency
cache.description: Cache-read vs creation tokens and the realized saving — the dominant Claude cost lever.
cache.hitRateCaption: cache reads as a share of all input tokens
cache.savingsCaption: from cache reads, priced per model
cache.chartSummary: {{read}} cache-read tokens vs {{uncached}} uncached input — a {{rate}} hit rate.
cache.note: The saving values cache-read tokens at the saved share of each model's base input rate; unpriced models contribute nothing. A zero saving is honest, not an error.

chargeback.title: Chargeback by dimension
chargeback.description: Slice spend by any attribution dimension the read-model carries.
chargeback.chartSummary: Spend by {{dimension}}, led by {{top}}; {{total}} across the range.
chargeback.empty: No spend recorded for {{dimension}} in this range.
chargeback.costTypeBilledOnly: Cost type is a billed-only breakdown (the cost_report server-tool split). The default spend stream is estimated, so this dimension is typically empty here — its real detail comes from reconciliation and the FOCUS export.
chargeback.costTypeEmpty: No cost-type detail on the estimated stream. Cost type is populated only on billed rows; see Reconciliation and the FOCUS export.
chargeback.serviceTierFreeform: Service-tier keys are rendered exactly as the API returns them; the documented tiers (standard, batch, priority, priority_on_demand, flex, flex_discount) are display hints, not a closed list.

costCentres.description: Accounting codes and the rules that bind spend to them.
costCentres.editDescription: The code cannot be changed: mapping rules resolve by it and issued statements record it.
costCentres.ingestOnlyNotice: ⛔ Mapping rules are applied AT INGESTION and stamped on each cost row. Creating or changing a rule does NOT re-attribute spend already recorded — it only affects costs ingested from now on.
costCentres.name: Name
costCentres.newDescription: A code is required. It is the accounting identity chargeback statements filter on.
costCentres.newRuleDescription: Bind one dimension value to this cost centre.
costCentres.priorityNote: The highest priority wins BETWEEN different dimensions. Within one dimension and key the engine reads a single rule and does not order by priority, so duplicates are resolved arbitrarily.
costCentres.rulesDescription: Which traffic binds to this cost centre.
costCentres.title: Cost centres
costCentres.truncated: Loaded {{n}} cost centres; there are more
costCentres.truncatedHint: There are more cost centres than shown; this page takes rows by id. A cost centre missing from this list does not demonstrate that it does not exist.
costCentres.rulesTruncatedHint: There are more mapping rules for this cost centre than shown; this page takes rows by id. For newly ingested cost the engine resolves matching rules independently of this page, so a resource that looks unmapped here may be mapped by a rule beyond it — and cost already recorded is not re-attributed when a rule is added.

description: Token cost across the estate — trends, chargeback, reconciliation, budgets and forecast. Figures are exactly as the FinOps ledger reports them.

alerts.title: No budget thresholds crossed yet
alerts.description: Create a budget with alert thresholds; an alert is recorded when an incoming cost sample takes consumption past one of them.

allocation.title: No agent-attributed cost to allocate yet
allocation.description: Once the cost stream carries an agent reference, that spend appears here; resource splits are added where access edges resolve.

anomalies.title: No spend anomalies detected yet
anomalies.description: A day appears once recorded spend reaches at least two standard deviations above the trailing-window baseline.

cacheEfficiencyChart.title: No input token usage recorded yet
cacheEfficiencyChart.description: Once cost samples carry input-token usage, uncached, cache-read and cache-creation volumes appear here.

dimensionChart.title: No spend recorded for this dimension
dimensionChart.description: Buckets appear once the selected dimension is present on the estimated cost stream; a dimension that no sample carries stays empty here.

futureBreakdowns.title: No future cost breakdowns cataloged
futureBreakdowns.description: Entries appear only when runtime cost breakdowns are added to the compiled reference; this table is not populated by live provider data.

futureDimensions.title: No future dimensions cataloged
futureDimensions.description: Entries appear only when future group-by dimensions are added to the compiled reference; this table is not populated by live provider data.

reconciliationChart.title: No billed spend to reconcile yet
reconciliationChart.description: Daily billed-versus-estimated spend appears once the Claude API cost_report poll supplies authoritative billed rows.

spend.title: No spend for this breakdown yet
spend.description: Once cost samples carry the selected model, provider or agent reference, ranked spend and token totals appear here.

export.title: FOCUS export
export.description: Export the cost read-model as a FOCUS v1.3 CSV (the FinOps Foundation's open cost-and-usage schema).
export.note: EffectiveCost is the sum-safe column; in the combined export estimated rows omit it so a naive SUM never double-counts the billed stream. Do not recompute totals from the CSV.

forecast.title: Period forecast
forecast.subtitle: A projection at the current run-rate, not a model.
forecast.runRateNote: The projection is a trailing-window daily run-rate scaled across the remaining period — at the current pace, not a forecasting model.

future.title: Future dimensions
future.description: Anthropic dimensions and cost breakdowns the platform exposes but the engine does not yet model as queryable slices.
future.caveat: Declared reference — AsOf {{date}}. These are not queryable slices yet; they are a catalog verified against the Anthropic docs, shown so the gap is visible, never as live data.

speed.label: Speed
speed.detail: Beta fast-mode (fast-mode-2026-02-01); a separate group_by the cost report exposes.

service_account_id.label: Service account
service_account_id.detail: A service-account (svac_) principal — distinct from the conflated API key the spend view serves today.

account_id.label: Account
account_id.detail: The owning account; a separate group_by not yet modeled by the read-model.

advisor.label: Advisor inference
advisor.detail: A second, hidden server-side inference billed separately in usage.iterations[].advisor_message.

thinking_tokens.label: Thinking tokens
thinking_tokens.detail: Extended-thinking tokens (usage.output_tokens_details.thinking_tokens), billed even when the thinking is omitted from display.

programmatic_tool_calling.label: Programmatic tool calling
programmatic_tool_calling.detail: Intermediate results land outside the context and outside usage, so cost/forensics under-count them.

optimization.title: Optimization recommendations
optimization.description: Candidate savings from the governed estate. Estimates are not a promise — verify capability and quality fit.
optimization.subject: Subject

outcomes.title: Graded outcomes
outcomes.description: The numerator of cost-per-outcome: what the spend actually achieved.
outcomes.gradeHint: The instant is captured now and re-sent unchanged on a retry, so a repeated submit cannot count the value twice.
outcomes.subject: Agent ref
outcomes.emptyHint: Without these, spend has no measurable value and every agent looks like pure cost.
outcomes.accepted: Accepted — the engine may have deduplicated it; the list below is the record
outcomes.truncatedHint: There are more recorded outcomes than shown; this page takes rows by id. Do not derive aggregate outcome or value totals from the loaded rows.

rates.title: Model rate catalogue
rates.description: List prices used to ESTIMATE cost when a provider does not report a dollar amount. These are not what you were billed.
rates.truncatedHint: There are more model rates than shown; this page is ordered by effective date, most recent first. Absence here does not establish absence from the catalog: costing and comparison resolve the effective rate from the catalog, independently of this page.

reconciliation.title: Billed vs estimated
reconciliation.description: How closely the derived estimate tracks the authoritative invoice. The two streams are never summed.
reconciliation.chartSummary: Billed {{billed}} vs estimated {{estimated}} over the range.

seats.title: Seat utilisation
seats.description: Assigned seats against the actors actually active, per day. A day with no seat snapshot reports nothing — it is not a day with zero usage.
seats.noSnapshot: no seat snapshot posted for this day

statements.description: Per-cost-centre, per-period snapshots with line items grouped by model, provider and agent — the artefact finance consumes for internal billing.
statements.snapshotNotice: A statement is a frozen snapshot: it is computed when generated and records the cost centre name and code as they were. Regenerating the same period does NOT recalculate it, so spend ingested afterwards will not appear.
statements.title: Chargeback statements
statements.truncatedHint: There are more chargeback statements than shown; this page is ordered by period start, most recent first. A period missing from this list does not demonstrate that nothing was billed for it.

title: Cost & FinOps

trend.title: Cost trend
trend.description: Daily token cost over the selected range.

value.title: Cost per outcome
value.description: Spend measured against graded outcomes. Unattributed spend is shown apart, not folded into the total.
value.riskDescription: Subjects burning spend without satisfied outcomes.
value.riskEmpty: No subject is burning spend without outcomes
